approved_scope.title: Keep SpecSync's own caches and journal outside the work tree
approved_scope.description: Keep SpecSync's own caches and journal outside the work tree
acceptance_criteria: SpecSync keeps its hash cache, transaction journal and remote spec cache outside the work tree: in <git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir>/specsync/<key>/ inside a Git work tree, keyed by the project's path in it, or in the user's cache folder (XDG_CACHE_HOME, ~/Library/Caches on macOS, ~/.cache elsewhere) keyed by the canonical project root when there is no work tree. A .specsync/hashes.json in the work tree, in any letter case and tracked or not, is never read or saved, so a forged pass in a clone, an unpacked tree or where Git cannot answer is never replayed. A .specsync/change-transaction.json in the work tree is never replayed: lifecycle commands refuse to start while it is there, with the path and how to clear it, without opening it. A .specsync-cache/remote-specs entry in the work tree is never used by resolve. The read and write scans cover exactly the files compiled into the binary (from Cargo's dep-info), skip only #[cfg(test)] items found by a lexer that ignores braces in strings, characters and comments, and also catch cap-std opens, renames and copies, tempfile_in and persist, hard and symbolic links, free functions imported from std::fs, and git arguments that write files; the hidden unbounded read in src/validator/tests.rs goes through the bounded read. The pre-commit hook is read, written, created, made executable and removed through a hooks folder opened component by component without following links, from the Git directory, the work tree top or the user's own folder, so a committed hooks folder link or a dangling pre-commit link is refused. The confinement widens to an enclosing work tree only when Git tracks the project root there. --template and --manifest stay as given; F5, F8, F9 and F10 of the second review are documented. The new tests fail on a2a50824 with only the tests added and pass with the fix

answers.constraints: util.3md: stay inside the root by construction, and enforce the same rule wherever a path is read, written, walked or replayed; a state file SpecSync writes for itself is never kept where a repository can put one. change.3md: a refusal is a result worth recording and names its recovery (#433, #847). Leif's option A (2026-11-19 ~21:09Z, answered 'a, all yes.. im back' ~00:38Z on 2026-11-20) bounds the scope: move the hash cache, journal and remote cache out of the work tree, into the Git directory or the user's cache folder; close the scan blind spots, the hooks-folder case and the enclosing-repo case; leave --template and --manifest as given and document the low-rated items. Change 5 stays open and is reviewed with this one.
